description: This file implements the client-side logic for registering push notifications via a relay server, including handling App Attest, receipt validation, and network communication. It defines errors, data models, and a main client class (PushRelayClient) that manages registration and challenge fetching.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptRefreshCoordinator
classes.description: Handles the refresh of the app receipt using StoreKit's SKReceiptRefreshRequest.

classes.name: PushRelayAppAttestService
classes.description: Manages App Attest key creation, attestation, and assertion generation.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptProvider
classes.description: Provides the device's App Store receipt, refreshing it if necessary.

classes.name: PushRelayClient
classes.description: Main client responsible for performing push registration by communicating with the relay server, handling App Attest, receipts, and challenge-response workflow.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Performs the push registration process, including challenge fetch, signing payloads, attestation, and network request.

methods.name: fetchChallenge
methods.description: Retrieves a registration challenge from the relay server.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into specified Decodable types.
